name: Chef's Table at Brooklyn Fare
changeNote: Back in the guide with two stars under a new team
changeNoteZh: 由新團隊主理，重回指南並獲二星

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Seafood-led, 12 or more courses, served whole; before tax and gratuity. Standard wine pairing $325, Premium $580, or a non-alcoholic pairing $215

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, or by phone or email (chefstable@brooklynfare.com). Seatings are Tuesday to Thursday at 6pm, 6:30pm, 7pm and 7:30pm, Friday and Saturday at 5pm, 5:30pm, 8:30pm and 8:45pm, and Sunday at 5pm, 5:30pm, 6pm and 6:30pm.
cancellation: A $200 deposit per guest is taken when booking, and Resy says it isn't refunded if you change or cancel. Guests 15 minutes or more late may miss courses or lose the booking.
groups: Online bookings take up to seven guests; for larger parties email chefstable@brooklynfare.com. The whole restaurant can be booked for a private dinner with at least two months' notice.
dressCode: No strict dress code, though many guests dress up.
duration: About two and a half hours or more.
